evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Directive issued from positional authority: mandates cadence and frames non-compliance as loss of capability, enacting hierarchy without negotiation.
Asserts cadence as settled fact from the owner position, ratifying the directive into standing operating reality.
Self-designation as owner enacts rank-based allocation of responsibility and authority over the rehearsal program.

mints.name: MandateAsExistentialCondition
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is authority here exercised by reframing non-compliance as the loss of the thing itself, not merely as a process gap?
